regime.label: Fearful, no panic
regime.summary: Tue midday: S&P 500 -1.0% (7,341), a fourth down day; Nasdaq -1.1%, VIX 26.2 (+14%), 10-year about 5.11%, Brent $93.86. Software hit hard (Salesforce -9.5%, ServiceNow -6.7%, SAP -5.6%). Europe closed lower (Reuters: Stoxx 600 -0.8%; DAX -2.1%, CAC -1.6%). VIX under 30: no panic selling of long-term holdings.

brief: US stocks fall for a fourth day before Nvidia's results tonight (S&P 500 about -1.0%, VIX about 26), and software sells off hard on AI fears (Salesforce about -9%). Today: no new buy; keep the CBRS $100 stop on the close and the Richemont CHF 170 limit, and act on Nvidia only Wed after 19:00 Dubai.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich

cards.name: Deutsche Bank
cards.trigger: WATCH only. No buy before Mon Nov 23. Then reconsider only if no regulator (BaFin, ECB, DOJ) opens a new probe.

cards.name: Luxury selloff: Hermes, Kering

cards.name: FLSmidth · Copenhagen
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy now. Reconsider only if a new CFO is named and FLS closes back above DKK 564 (Nov 12 level). Now DKK 508.
